body.statement: Along the explicit path \(n_\ell=2\ell\) and \(m_\ell=2\lceil\gamma\ell\rceil\), determine the asymptotic order of \(\inf_{\widetilde U\in\mathfrak E_{n_\ell,m_\ell}}\sup_{P\in\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{pred}}_{n_\ell,m_\ell}(r,\mu,K,q,B,\lambda)}E_P[\mathcal L(\widetilde U,U)]\) between the proved \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\) lower benchmark and the constant hybrid upper endpoint. If its order is \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\), determine \(C_\star\) and whether an observed-data estimator attains it. Also characterize whether a nonconstant predictable propensity path can be least favorable. The recorded-IPW obstruction is estimator-specific and cannot decide the first question.
body.justification: The live question is first the estimator-independent order between the \(b_{nm}\) lower benchmark and the constant hybrid endpoint; a sharp constant comes only after that gap closes.
body.gap: Construct a uniformly vanishing observed-data estimator or prove an estimator-independent lower bound above \(b_{nm}\), without adding exogeneity or singular-factor predictability.
body.consumer: A resolution determines whether uniform row-subspace learning is possible before any sharp-efficiency calculation.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine whether the minimax expected normalized maximum-row risk is of order \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\), of constant order, or at an intermediate rate; only after that decide the sharp normalized constant and least-favorable propensity structure.
obligation.obstruction: The constant-propensity packing lower-bounds every estimator only at order \(b_{nm}\). The sine hybrid supplies a constant upper endpoint, while the endogenous-target construction obstructs only recorded IPW--SVD. None of these results gives an estimator-independent lower bound above \(b_{nm}\) or a uniformly vanishing observed-data estimator on the full predictable class.
obligation.attempted: A row-local constant-propensity Fano packing, the matrix-Freedman IPW upper, the accepted endogenous-target witness, and a deterministic sine-frame fallback were combined. They close the bracket from \(c b_{nm}\) to a constant but do not identify the intervening minimax order.
obligation.partial_result: The constant-propensity packing proves a positive \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\)-normalized lower bound when \(\mu>1\).  The sine-frame hybrid is one observed-data estimator with risk at most \(C(1\wedge a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{n_\ell m_\ell})\).  Nonemptiness under bounded outcomes forces \(\lambda_{n_\ell m_\ell}\le2B\sqrt{n_\ell m_\ell}\); at fixed \(r,\mu,K,q\) and bounded aspect ratio, the resulting \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}\) and blind \(d\) radii are bounded below by order \(\sqrt{\log n_\ell}\), so this uniform upper endpoint is eventually only constant.  The endogenous-factor witness proves that recorded IPW--SVD need not attain the \(b\) scale, but it gives no lower bound for every observed-data estimator.  Hence the presently proved minimax bracket runs from \(c b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\) to a constant and does not determine \(C_\star\).
